override.title: Admin Override
override.hint: Malu adibu bashintulula adi misangu yonso mafunda ne bumuntu buebe bua mulombodi ne bualu - ki mmupuwe nansha kakese.
override.cancelBookingHint: Dilekela didi dileja ne: dilomba dia nzubu ne mudimu wende mbipangishibue, didi dipingaja bumfumu bua mudimu kudi muena mudimu nende, ne didi dilekela muenji wa nzubu ufunda kabidi mukanda eu.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Kulekela dilomba edi anyi? Mudimu wandi udi kabidi mujimijibua. Bidi bifunda ne dina diebe ne bualu buebe.

detail.disputeOpen: Dikokangana dia bumfumu didi pa mutu pa muena mudimu eu - muena mudimu mukuabu udi wamba ne: mbuabu. Bidi bipangadika pa dibeji dia bilumbu.

cancellation.title: Dilomba diakajika
cancellation.hint: Difunda dia nzubu ne difutu diawu mbijimijibue; bumfumu bua mudimu budi bupingana kudi muena mudimu ne muibaki udi mua kufunda kabidi mukanda eu.

disputes.title: Malu a bumfumu
disputes.hint: Muena mudimu uvuabu babenge bua kudifundisha bu tshintu tshibidi udi mua kuela mpata bua nganyi udi muena tshisalu. Tangila nseke yonso ibidi ne wangate dipangadika.
disputes.empty: Kakuena bilumbu ne nsombelu eu to.

detail.title: Dikokangana {{id}}
detail.heldMissing: Difundisha divuabu balame kadivua mua kupetekibua to.
detail.upholdEffect: {{holder}} udi ulama muena mudimu. Dikokangana didi dijika ne kakuena bualu bukuabu budi bushintuluka to.
detail.overturnEffect: {{holder}} 's duplicate protection udi ujika mpindieu ne muena mudimu mmufunda kudi {{partner}} bu difunda dipiadipia.
